messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@appsecure.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-enterprises.com
Date: 2026-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staggered rollout & bridge-license proposal for EDR / MDM consolidation

Team / Alicia —

Following up on last week's consolidation readout: we need a pragmatic rollout approach that avoids a large cutover risk while capturing the $200k+ annual savings from decommissioning two legacy agents. Proposal in the attached matrix: a staggered, 6-week rollout broken into three canary cohorts (10%, 30%, 60%) with rollback windows and an optional 90-day bridge license for the legacy EDR to cover overlap. Key asks:

- Alicia: can AppSecure price a 90-day bridge license and confirm support SLA for canary rollbacks? Also include SOC 2/RWG evidence we can hand off to InfoSec.
- Jonas: can you validate the agent telemetry/data retention impact for our analytics pipeline (expected 12% additional token ingestion during canaries)?
- Hannah/Laura: procurement timeline — what's the latest PO date to hit the November invoice period?

I've attached the transition matrix (MDM_EDR_transition_matrix.xlsx) that maps cohorts to business units and agent versions. I recommend we keep Finance in the loop for the bridge license to avoid surprises.

Next step: Alicia to confirm pricing and timeline, internal stakeholders to sign off on the cohort list by Friday.

Thanks,
So-

--
Soojin Lee
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@appsecure.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered rollout & bridge-license proposal for EDR / MDM consolidation

+1 on the staggered approach. A few quick counters/notes:

- Licensing counts: the current fleet is 4,800 endpoints; recommended bridge for 90 days should be sized for ~5,100 to absorb provisioning drift. If AppSecure offers per-endpoint billing, we'll need a capped spend line.
- Canary cohorts: suggest we pick horizontal slices (by office/AD-group) rather than biz-unit to make rollback deterministic.
- Telemetry: expect a brief spike in KV cache population and our ingestion pipeline — I estimate up to 15% higher for the first week of the canary but then back to baseline. We should set a short retention tweak so observability dashboards don't spike storage costs.

Also: add a rollback play for agent auto-updater in case the new MDM profile conflicts with legacy scripts. Happy to sync with infra on Wed.

On procurement timing: if we sign SOW by Oct 20 we can get the bridge invoiced in November as requested.

Jonas
VP, Infrastructure
